settings.headline_accent2: Nothing lost between the peak and you.
settings.body_text:
We stood on a slope so steep to need both hands to climb it. Someone twice our age walked past carrying twice what we had.

The best of everything really does grow where it's hardest to reach.

Everything on this page came off a mountain in weather that would send most people back down. Whoever made it didn't have that option.

So we go up as well. 

We sit with the producers, agree on a price together, buy their whole season in one go, and pay it upfront. After that, we don't touch what they made - the recipe, the method, the name on it; all of it stays theirs.
settings.source_text: SOURCED ACROSS UTTARAKHAND · HIMACHAL · LADAKH · KASHMIR

settings.heading_line1: “Natural”. We want to be why you trust that word again.
settings.paragraph_1:
Somewhere along the way, the words stopped meaning anything. 
Natural. Pure. Organic. 
They get printed on things that are none of those. And slowly, people stopped believing the label at all. We're building the opposite of that.
What we're after is hard to pull off. Every product has to trace back to a real person who made it. Nothing here asks for blind faith.
We get there by going straight to the people who grow and make. They're paid fairly for what they do. Nothing about the process stays hidden.
Do this long enough, and it becomes the bar every brand has to meet.
settings.quote_line2: Exactly as it left their hands, all the way here.

settings.heading_before_italic: The rarest food on earth, grown pure, delivered straight to you.

settings.title: Traceability
settings.text: We can point to the exact farm, family, and harvest behind it.

settings.title: Accountability
settings.text: FSSAI-licensed, hand-graded, and cleared batch by batch before shipping.

settings.title: Seasonality
settings.text: One harvest a year for most of it, nothing forced or rushed.

settings.title: Patience
settings.text: Grown slowly, picked in season, sold only when it's ready.

settings.title: Rarity
settings.text: Grown in pockets so remote most of India never gets to taste them.

settings.subtitle: OUR VALUES
settings.heading: The rules every batch must pass.
settings.description: Every product that leaves us clears all five. They're less a promise to you, more a promise to ourselves.
settings.highlight_text: Ask us to prove any of it. Please do.

settings.name: Himanshu Dua
settings.quote: "I want every Indian household to taste the mountains."

settings.name: Shubham Tandon
settings.quote: "Sourcing is a relationship — not a transaction."

settings.name: Mohd Anas Zubair
settings.quote: "We measure success in farmer incomes, not just revenue."

settings.name: Rohan Sehgal
settings.quote: "If a customer isn't delighted, we haven't done our job."

settings.description:
We agree on almost everything, the four of us.

That farmers deserve better. That purity should mean something. That the mountains make the best food in India. That it's stuck in villages nobody reaches.

The last part, though, we flatly refused to accept, and that's how all of this began.

settings.left_heading: Trusted by the country's finest institutions.
